title: Enantioseparation of racemic compounds in capillary electrophoresis using cationic single isomer cyclodextrin
protocol: Add a certain amount of NaH2PO4•2H2O into ultra-pure water to prepare 50 mM NaH2PO4 stock solutions.
Adjust the pH of NaH2PO4 solutions using 1 M NaOH until reaching the desired pH (generally 6~9).
Add a certain amount of CD selector into the NaH2PO4 solution to obtain the desired CD concentration (generally 0~30 mM).
Add a certain amount of organic modifier (MeOH or ACN) (generally 0~20%, vol/vol) into the solutions.
Transfer 1.5 mL of the prepared buffer into two 2 mL-vials.
Degas the buffer before use.
Add a certain amount of racemic analytes into a 50/50 (vol/vol) methanol/water mixture to form stock solutions of 50 μg•mL-1.
Transfer 1.5 mL of the stock solution into 2 mL-vials.
Degas the analyte solution before use.
Flush the capillary using 1 M NaOH solution for 30 min.
Flush the capillary using 0.1 M NaOH solution for 30 min.
Flush the capillary using ultra-pure water for 30 min.
Flush the capillary using running buffer for 15 min.
Put the cartridge with fused-silica capillary on the CE equipment and place the two buffer vials and one analyte vial in the sample trays.
Set sample injection by pressure at 0.5 psi for 4 s.
Set the separation voltage as 15 kV.
Start injection and separation.
Collect separation data and stop running.
Flush the capillary using 1 M NaOH solution for 4 min.
Flush the capillary using ultra-pure water for 4 min.
Flush the capillary using running buffer for 4 min.
Start the next run.
